=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1976-2046 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: A live-log cooldown skip in `review_run_checked_out_bait()` sets `coverage_failed=1` and leaves the verdict `unknown` with `reason=logs_unavailable`, so `require_bait_review_coverage()` counts it as a strike. After 3 polls (~30s against a 300s cooldown) the run id is added to `BAIT_UNCOVERED_RUN_IDS`, which the selector filters at line 2191, so the exclusion is permanent and the log is never fetched.
  WHY: A valid completed pre-bait review is dropped without any log read, and Phase 4 can time out waiting for a bait-head review (`status=no_review_triggered` or `status=timeout`, exit 1). Severity disagreement: reviewers rated it MAJOR (anthropic, gemini, luna) and BLOCKER (minimax, qwen); the highest is used.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1976-1982 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The cooldown state and the `LIVE_LOG_FETCH_FAILURES` counter are shared between the live-log shortcut fetch, the log-size fetch and the bait-coverage check.
  WHY: Three bait-coverage failures can trip the cooldown and disable the other, healthy log fetches, or the reverse.
- tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_live_log_cooldown.py:99-106 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `test_bait_coverage_fetch_records_outcome` only asserts that `live_log_fetch_allowed` and one `ok` and one `fail` `live_log_fetch_record` call are present. It does not check that a cooldown skip is distinct from a genuine unknown verdict or that a skip adds no strike.
  WHY: The suite stays green while the permanent-exclusion bug is present. Severity disagreement: anthropic and minimax rated it NIT and qwen rated it MAJOR; the highest is used.
- changelog.d/wfopt-0922-3-release-live-log-cooldown.md:4 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The entry says the bait-coverage check "reports the logs as unavailable during the pause and checks again after it", but the code never re-checks a run excluded during the pause.
  WHY: The fragment becomes the operator-facing description of release-gate behaviour and promises a retry the code cannot perform.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The cooldown covers all three job-log fetches of the wait: the live-log shortcut fetch, the log-size fetch and the bait-coverage check, which reports the logs as unavailable during the pause and checks again after it.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml — review_run_checked_out_bait() (1954-2018) and the unknown-counter branch of require_bait_review_coverage() (2036-2046)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: Neither function re-verifies a skipped check, and line 2043 appends the run id to `BAIT_UNCOVERED_RUN_IDS` on the third skipped poll, which line 2191 filters out permanently. A cooldown skip cannot be told apart from a genuine unknown verdict, so a skipped run is never retried after the pause.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1976-1982, 2004-2005, 2036-2046 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: During a live-log cooldown, `review_run_checked_out_bait()` sets `coverage_failed=1` without fetching a log, so the verdict stays `unknown` with `reason=logs_unavailable`. `require_bait_review_coverage()` adds a strike per poll and, after 3, appends the run id to `BAIT_UNCOVERED_RUN_IDS`, which the selector filters at line 2191 permanently.
  WHY: With `POLL_INTERVAL: 10` (line 584) and a 300s cooldown, a valid in-flight review is dropped without any fetch. Phase 4 can then wait for a bait-head review until `REVIEW_PHASE_DEADLINE` and time out. The "stayed unverifiable" warning is also wrong, because coverage was never tried.
- TASK_GAP: requirement: The changelog fragment says the cooldown covers the bait-coverage check, "which reports the logs as unavailable during the pause and checks again after it". | expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml`, `review_run_checked_out_bait()` (1954-2018) and the unknown-counter branch of `require_bait_review_coverage()` (2036-2046); changelog is `changelog.d/wfopt-0922-3-release-live-log-cooldown.md` | confidence=4 | severity=MAJOR
  EVIDENCE: Nothing in either function re-checks a run whose check was skipped. A completed run skipped for three polls is added to `BAIT_UNCOVERED_RUN_IDS` (line 2043) and never checked again, so "checks again after it" is not true for completed runs.
- tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_live_log_cooldown.py:99-106 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `test_bait_coverage_fetch_records_outcome` only asserts that `live_log_fetch_allowed` and one `ok` and one `fail` `live_log_fetch_record` appear. It does not assert that a cooldown skip is kept apart from a genuine unknown verdict or adds no strike.
  WHY: The suite stays green while the permanent-exclusion bug is present.
- HARDENING: `review_run_checked_out_bait()` cooldown branch and the completed branch of `require_bait_review_coverage()`: set `BAIT_REVIEW_COOLED=1` in the cooldown branch, increment the strike only when it is not 1, and reset it at the start of `review_run_checked_out_bait()` (about 5 lines, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3).

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1980 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `live_log_fetch_record()` as used in `require_bait_review_coverage()` leads to permanent exclusion of run IDs after three failed fetch attempts.
  WHY: With `LIVE_LOG_FAILURE_THRESHOLD` at 3, three failures add the run ID to `BAIT_UNCOVERED_RUN_IDS`, which line 2191 filters out, without ever reading the logs or verifying bait coverage. This violates the intent to report logs as unavailable and retry later.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1976-1982 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The cooldown shares the `LIVE_LOG_FETCH_FAILURES` counter and cooldown state between the live-log shortcut fetch, the log-size fetch and the bait-coverage check.
  WHY: Three bait-coverage failures can trip the cooldown and disable the other fetches even if those endpoints are healthy, or the reverse.
- TASK_GAP: requirement: the cooldown covers all three job-log fetches of the wait: the live-log shortcut fetch, the log-size fetch and the bait-coverage check, which reports the logs as unavailable during the pause and checks again after it. | expected_change_site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml — review_run_checked_out_bait() (1954-2018) and the unknown-counter branch of require_bait_review_coverage() (2036-2046) | confidence=4 | severity=MAJOR
  EVIDENCE: No hunk in either function adds a re-verification path for a skipped check. Line 2043 appends to `BAIT_UNCOVERED_RUN_IDS` on the third skipped poll and line 2191 filters those ids out permanently, so the paused check is never retried.
- HARDENING: `live_log_fetch_record()`: treat an 'unknown' argument as a no-op instead of incrementing the failure count, e.g. `if [ "$1" = "ok" ]; then LIVE_LOG_FETCH_FAILURES=0; return 0; fi; if [ "$1" = "fail" ]; then ...` (1 line, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1).

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1976-1982, 2004-2005, 2036-2045, 2047-2048, 2191, 2566-2581 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A cooldown skip in `review_run_checked_out_bait()` is reported as an ordinary unreadable log (`coverage_failed=1`, verdict `unknown`, `coverage_reason="logs_unavailable"`) without calling `live_log_fetch_record`. `require_bait_review_coverage()` counts each `unknown` verdict on a completed run as a strike, and `BAIT_UNCOVERED_RUN_IDS` is never pruned.
  WHY: With `POLL_INTERVAL=10` and `LIVE_LOG_COOLDOWN_SECS=300`, three strikes cost about 30s without one fetch attempt, and the selector at line 2191 then drops the run id. If no bait-head candidate survives, the job exits 1 with `status=no_review_triggered` or `status=timeout`, a false release-gate failure. This re-creates the starvation that the leg-(b) block at lines 2116-2140 was written to avoid.

  WHY: The fragment becomes the operator-facing description of release-gate behaviour and promises a retry the code cannot perform.

  PROBLEM: `test_bait_coverage_fetch_records_outcome` asserts only that `live_log_fetch_allowed` appears and that one `ok` and one `fail` `live_log_fetch_record` exist. It asserts nothing about the consequence of a cooldown skip.
  WHY: CI returns 0 with the exclusion bug present, so it cannot catch a reintroduction.
- HARDENING: `review_run_checked_out_bait()`, the `if ! live_log_fetch_allowed; then` branch at line 1978: set `coverage_reason="live_log_cooldown"` before the `logs_unavailable` fallback at 2005, so the echo at line 2017 prints a distinct reason (2 lines, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3).
